name: Indonesia
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Kolintang
inventions.description: Kolintang is a traditional Minahasan percussion instrument from North Sulawesi, Indonesia, consisting of wooden blades arranged in a row and mounted on a wooden tub.

inventions.name: Surakarta (game)
inventions.description: Surakarta is an Indonesian abstract strategy board game for two players, named after Surakarta, Central Java.

inventions.name: Proa
inventions.description: Proas are various types of multi-hull outrigger sailboats of the Austronesian peoples.

inventions.name: Londe
inventions.description: Londe or londi is a traditional boat from North Sulawesi, Indonesia.

inventions.name: Lepa-lepa (dugout canoe)
inventions.description: Lepa-lepa is a traditional canoe from the eastern part of the Indonesian archipelago.

inventions.name: Lambo (boat)
inventions.description: The term lambo or lamba refer to two types of traditional boats from Indonesia.

inventions.name: Solu
inventions.description: A solu is a traditional boat of the Toba Batak people of North Sumatra, Indonesia.

inventions.name: Lantaka
inventions.description: The lantaka, also known as the rentaka, was a type of bronze portable cannon or swivel gun, sometimes mounted on merchant vessels and warships in Maritime Southeast Asia.

inventions.name: Kretek
inventions.description: Kretek is a type of Indonesian cigarette made with a blend of tobacco, cloves and other flavors.
